Introduction to First Health Network

This breaks down to approximately 2,079 individuals living with an alcohol use disorder, 1,204 individuals living with an illicit drug use disorder, and 192 abusing pain medications. The prevalence of substance use disorders in our state is concerning and shows the importance of having quality and accessible healthcare in our community.

What is First Health Network Insurance?

A common concern that many have about getting help for their drug or alcohol use, is their ability to afford it. It is well known that addiction treatments, especially inpatient services, are expensive. Individuals who expect to be in treatment for an extended period can also find this to be a deterrent.

First Health Network Insurance is a leading healthcare provider across the United States. First Health Network has approximately 45 million individuals within its network across the country. Members live in rural, suburban, and urban areas.

Does First Health Network Cover Inpatient Drug Rehab Treatment?

First Health Network often provides coverage for inpatient treatment. Individuals who are living with a substance use disorder and other mental health concerns are eligible to receive dual diagnosis treatment, which would meet all of their treatment needs. First Health Network covers inpatient rehab programs. These programs often utilize a combination of individual therapy, group therapy, and educational sessions within its program.

If you would like clarification about your healthcare plan, we encourage you to contact First Health Network directly. You can do this by calling the phone number provided on your insurance card, or utilizing their website. Speaking directly with a representative allows you to ask questions and get a solid understanding of what your financial responsibility would be for various treatment options.

Does First Health Network Cover Drug Detox?

Detoxification is a common step for individuals who are living with a substance use disorder. Stopping the use of drugs and alcohol can shock our bodies which can cause discomfort, pain, and potentially lead to medical complications.

First Health Network may provide you with drug detox coverage. While mental health and substance abuse treatment fall under the Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act of 2008, detoxification is not a required component of addiction treatment.

If your First Health Network plan does cover detoxification, you may be eligible to submit a claim to your provider after you have paid the amount specified in your deductible. We strongly encourage you to contact First Health Network to learn about the details of your policy, and if detoxification services are covered.

We encourage you to contact First Health Network directly to learn more about your coverage. A representative can provide you with an understanding of what treatment forms would be covered, and what your financial responsibility would look like.
